description: Write a message as a ready-to-paste Slack message, in nvie's own casual voice, using Slack-flavored markdown that formats correctly when pasted into the Slack composer and toggled with cmd+shift+f. Use when the user runs /slack, or asks to "write this as a Slack message", "slackify this", "draft a Slack message", or "post this in Slack". Output is the message text and nothing else -- no preamble, no explanation, no follow-up questions.
